headline: Breaking! JCI Falls 1% After BI Rate Rises to 6%
summary: The Jakarta Composite Index fell 1% in the afternoon session after Bank Indonesia raised its benchmark rate to 6%, with trading volume reaching Rp 8.59 trillion.
why: Bank Indonesia sets the country's benchmark interest rate, and rate increases raise borrowing costs and can weigh on equity valuations.
why_moved: Bank Indonesia raised its benchmark rate to 6%, and the index fell 1% in the afternoon session.
original_headline: Breaking! IHSG Turun 1% Usai BI Rate Naik Jadi 6%
